item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 03/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The weather will be generally fine over the region, it will be warm during the day. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China over the weekend, it will be dry with cool mornings over the region early next week. With the monsoon moderating midweek next week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly.
